11 observations kept from 41 archive versions, 2025-01-08T20:34:03Z to 2025-01-14T22:41:47Z (10 inside the replay window). Time = PolygonDateTime, else DateCurrent; 31 versions carried a stale PolygonDateTime (set by an earlier version with a different polygon) and use DateCurrent. Dropped 2 InFORM placeholder versions (single 3-vertex triangles sized to the reported acreage, not mapped perimeters): 379 at 2025-01-08T06:00:47Z, 2,919.3 ac; 408 at 2025-01-08T14:31:44Z, 2,919.3 ac. First mapped perimeter: 2025-01-08T20:34:03Z (version 452, 11,799 ac, 26.1 h after the reported start 2025-01-07T18:30:00Z). Dropped: 20 re-saves or duplicates (under 1% different), 1 stub(s) under 5 ac, 7 versions of other incidents with the same name outside the AOI, 6 stray polygon parts outside the AOI (0.03 ac) in versions 557, 567. Each feature is the cumulative union of observations so far, clipped to the final extent (version 1633, 23,447 ac). Unclipped, the union ends at 24,526 ac (+4.6% vs official); most of the excess is early mapping outside the final extent: 544 773 ac, 452 256 ac, 666 217 ac. Final cumulative 23,445 ac vs official 23,449 ac (-0.0%). Area check: the CAL FIRE final perimeter measures 23,447.0 ac in this frame vs its GIS_ACRES 23,448.9 (-0.01%). 20 candidate spot components (< 50 ac, > 10 m from the main footprint) in spots.geojson, timed by the observation that first maps them, not by when they ignited.
